senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (विधते)
1 To administer, to govern, to rule or command.
2 To pierce, to perforate.

mf. (-धः-धा)
1 Form, formula, rule.
2 Manner, kind, sort.
3 Fodder, the food of horses, elephants, &c.
4 Prosperity, thriving.
5 Hire, wages.
6 Act, action.
7 Piercing.
E.
वि before धा to have, aff. क, or अङ्, and fem. aff. टाप्; or विध to rule, &c., aff. क; the masculine form, though it does occur, is not common, except in composition, when the word is used attributively, as द्विविध of two sorts. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं), &c.

n. (-नं)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
वि before धू to shake, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-वा)
A widow.
E.
वि privative, धव a husband.

m. (-मी)
One who has intercourse with a widow.
E.
विधवा, and गामिन् who approaches, (carnally.)

n. (-नं)
Marrying a widow.
E.
विधवा, and आवेदन marrying.

n. (-व्यं)
Trembling, tremor.
E.
वि before धू to shake, aff. यत्.

n. (-व्यं)
Shaking, agitation.
E.
वि before घू to shake, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-धाः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
वि severally or every kind, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and the radical vowel dropped.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be done or performed.
2 To be done according to rule, to be observed as a rite or ceremony.
3 To be ruled or regulated.
E.
वि before धा to have, तव्य aff.

m. (-ता)
1 BRAHMĀ.
2 Love or KĀMA.
3 Fate.
E.
वि severally, धा to have or contain, (all things,) aff. तृच्.

m. (-भूः)
NĀRADA, the Muni and son of BRAHMĀ.
E.
विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and भू offspring.

m. (-युः)
The sun-flower.

f. (-त्री)
Long-pepper.
E.
वि before धा to have, तृच् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.

n. (-नं)
1 Act, action, general or particular, though more especially the performance of such acts or rites as are prescribed in the sacred books of the Hindus.
2 Rule, precept, ordinance, injunction.
3 An elephant's fodder.
4 Form, mode, manner.
5 Sending, ordering.
6 Means, expedient.
7 Wealth.
8 Worship.
9 Active enmity or act of hostility.
10 Gaining, getting, taking.
11 Conflict or contrast of opposite feelings.
12 (In grammar,) Affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c.
E.
वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having, possessing, assuming, wearing.
E.
वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.

n. (-कं)
Pain.
E.
वि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added.

m. (-गः)
A Paṇḍita, a wise or learned man or teacher.
E.
विधान action, the performance of those acts prescribed by the Śāstras, and ग who goes or performs.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A Paṇḍita, &c.: see the last.
E.
विधान, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
Having taken, assumed, put on, placed, &c.
E.
वि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Consigning, delivering, one who entrusts or deposits any thing, or causes it to be fixed or secure.
E.
वि before धा to have, (causal form,) aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-त्वं)
Consignment or delivery of any thing, making any thing firm or secure.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, विधायकता.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Causing, occasioning, making.
2 Placing, fixing, securing.
3 Delivering, entrusting.
4 Establishing as a rule or law.
E.
वि before धा to have or hold, causal form, aff. धिनुण्.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यती-स्यत्)
1 Purposing or willing to do, make, cause, &c.
2 Intending to direct, enjoin, prescribe, &c.
E.
वि before धा to have, शतृ aff. in the future tense.

m. (-धिः)
1 A sacred precept, an act or rite prescribed by the Vedas for effecting certain consequences.
2 Rule, form, formula.
3 Fate, luck, destiny.
4 BRAHMĀ.
5 Time.
6 Order, injunction, command.
7 A name of VIṢṆU.
8 Act, action, general or particular.
9 A text, a sentence in some authority of law or religion, prescribing any particular act or observance.
10 Kind, sort, manner.
11 Fodder, food for elephants or horses.
12 A sacred work, a Śāstra, scripture, the law, (by metonymy.)
E.
वि before धा to have, or विध to rule, aff. कि.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Who or what deviates from, disregards, or disturbs rules or modes of proceeding.
E.
विधि, and घ्न what destroys.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Who or what knows the prescribed mode, form, &c.
m. (-ज्ञः)
A Brahman who knows the ritual.
E.
विधि, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
According to rule.
E.
विधि, and तसि aff.

f. (-त्सा)
Wish to do or make, design, purpose, desire.
E.
वि before धा to have, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing to make, produce, &c.
E.
वि before धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-र्शी)
A priest whose business at a sacrifice is to see that every thing is done according to the prescribed rules, and to correct any deviation from them.
E.
विधि a sacred precept, and दर्शिन् who sees; also विधिदर्शक, &c.

m. (-कः)
A priest who corrects errors at a sacrifice: see the last.
E.
विधि the proper form, and देशक who shews.

n. adv. (-कं)
After or according to rule.
E.
विधि, and पर्व्वक prior.

m. (-गः)
Acting upon or in conformity to a rule, &c.
E.
विधि, and प्रयोग application.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Application of or acting upon a rule.
E.
विधि, and प्रसङ्ग association.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A ceremonial act of worship.
E.
विधि precept, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

m. (-गः)
1 The occurrence of predoomed events.
2 Combination for any act or rite.
E.
विधि, and योग union, accession.

ind.
Agreeable to rule, conformably to established ordinances.
E.
विधि a precept, and वति aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unauthorised, irregular.
E.
विधि, and हीन abandoned.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being defined, enjoined, directed, &c.
E.
वि before धा to have, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-धुः)
1 The moon.
2 VIṢṆU.
3 Camphor.
4 A name of BRAHMĀ.
5 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin.
6 An expiatory oblation.
E.
व्यध to pain or hurt, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the semivowel changed.

m. (-यः)
The wane of the moon.
E.
विधु, and क्षय decay.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left, abandoned, relinquished.
2 Shaken, trembling.
E.
वि before धु to tremble, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaken.
2 Trembling, tremulous.
3 Unsteady.
4 Abandoned.
5 Tossed, waving.
E.
वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-तिः)
Shaking, agitation, tremor.
E.
वि before घू to shake, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-नं)
Tremour, trembling, shaking.
E.
वि before धू in the 10th cl. to shake, aff. ल्युट्, and the vowel short; also विधूनन.

n. (-नं)
Shaking, trembling, tremor.
E.
वि before घू to agitate, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-दः)
RĀHU, the personified ascending node.
E.
विध the moon, तुद to torment, aff. खश् or क, and the nasal inserted, the cause of the moon's eclipse.

mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वती-न्वत्)
Shaking, tossing.
E.
वि before घु to agitate, शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
A scimitar, a sabre.

f. (-या)
A lunar mansion; in mythology, personified as a nymph, the daughter of DAKṢA, and wife of CANDRA or the moon.
E.
बिधु the moon, and प्रिया the beloved.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Agitated, distressed, overcome with anxiety, distress, &c.
2 Bewildered, confused, (with fear, liquor, &c.)
3 Separate, absent from a mistress or lover.
n. (-रं)
1 Separation.
2 Agitation of mind from terror or distress, &c.
f. (-रा)
Curds mixed up with sugar and spices.
E.
वि before धुर् a load, a burthen, aff. अप्.

n. (-नं)
Trembling, tremor.
E.
वि before धू to agitate, ल्युट् aff., and उवङ augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaken, (literally or figuratively,) agitated, alarmed.
2 Harassed, annoyed.
E.
वि before धू to shake, 10th cl. aff. क्त.

ind.
Having shaken, shaking, trembling.
E.
वि before धू to shake, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being shaken, shaking, waving, agitated.
E.
वि before धू to shake, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seized, held.
2 Withheld, restrained.
3 Having, possessing, assumed, taken.
n. (-तं)
1 Disregard of an injunction or desire.
2 Dissatisfaction.
E.
वि before धृत held.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Compliant, tractable, governable.
2 To be done, what is or ought to be practised.
3 Proper to be enjoined as a rule or law.
E.
वि before धा to have, यत् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Necessary or proper act or conduct.
2 Docility, submission.
3 Fitness for enactment as a rule or law.
E.
तल् added to the last; also विधेयत्वं.

n. (-र्गं)
Attempting or seeking to do any necessary act.
E.
विधेय, and मार्ग seeking.

n. (-दं)
An affair to be done, an object to be accomplished.
E.
विधेय, and पद place.

mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्)
Piercing, striking, killing.
E.
व्यध to pierce, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being pierced, struck, wounded, &c.
E.
व्यध to pierce, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Aversion, disrespect, enmity, dislike.
2 Offence, insult.
3 Destruction.
E.
वि before ध्वंस to fall, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
1 Hostile, adverse.
2 Destroying.
E.
वि before ध्वंस to fall, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं)
Clean, clear, pure.
E.
वि before इन्ध to shine, Uṇādi aff. रक, and the first consonant rejected.
